Safety meaning (consent copy): the warning and the required checkbox name {device}, the DESTINATION, as the receiver of ALL working files (worktrees with unpushed commits and uncommitted changes, scratch files, session memory); the _leave/_without/_unknown variants and checkbox_leave say the files stay and the conversation on {device} will not have them; working_set_error keeps 'review before anything is sent'. working_set_warning: «تمام ورکنگ فائلیں {device} پر بھیج دی جاتی ہیں»; working_set_checkbox: «مجھے یقین ہے کہ {device} کو یہ فائلیں ملنی چاہئیں».

Glossary consistency across the two sides: move = منتقل کرنا / منتقلی (= mesh_card.move_to «پر منتقل کریں», mesh_page «منتقلی کی درخواست»); device = ڈیوائس with feminine agreement throughout, same as #1984 pairing keys («شیئر کرے گی», «شامل ہو گئی»); share = شیئر (= #1984); worktree = ورک ٹری.
